changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Feedback stored as delivered while one of its copies failed or never posted reads failed or unconfirmed, as the delivery projection now records it.
changeSet.sql: SET LOCAL lock_timeout='30s'; CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE corrected ON COMMIT DROP AS SELECT f.workspace_id,f.id, COALESCE((SELECT d.action='WITHDRAW' FROM feedback_decision d WHERE d.workspace_id=f.workspace_id AND d.feedback_id=f.id AND d.action IN ('WITHDRAW','RESTORE') ORDER BY d.decided_at DESC,d.id::text DESC LIMIT 1),false) AS withdrawn FROM feedback f WHERE f.destination='ON_WORK' AND f.state='DELIVERED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM feedback_send s WHERE s.workspace_id=f.workspace_id AND s.feedback_id=f.id AND s.state<>'DONE') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM feedback_copy c WHERE c.workspace_id=f.workspace_id AND c.feedback_id=f.id AND c.state IN ('WRITE_STARTED','FAILED','PLANNED')); UPDATE feedback_copy c SET state='FAILED',readback='ABSENT',last_error='No provider request was admitted.' FROM corrected r WHERE c.workspace_id=r.workspace_id AND c.feedback_id=r.id AND NOT r.withdrawn AND c.state='PLANNED' AND (c.write_started_at IS NULL OR c.readback='ABSENT'); UPDATE feedback f SET state=CASE WHEN c.started THEN 'UNCONFIRMED' WHEN c.failed THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'UNCONFIRMED' END, stop_reason=CASE WHEN c.failed AND NOT c.started THEN NULL ELSE 'DELIVERY_UNCONFIRMED' END FROM ( SELECT k.workspace_id,k.feedback_id, bool_or(k.state='WRITE_STARTED') AS started,bool_or(k.state='FAILED') AS failed FROM feedback_copy k JOIN corrected r ON r.workspace_id=k.workspace_id AND r.id=k.feedback_id WHERE k.state IN ('WRITE_STARTED','FAILED','PLANNED') GROUP BY k.workspace_id,k.feedback_id ) c WHERE c.workspace_id=f.workspace_id AND c.feedback_id=f.id;

rollback.stop: Restore the verified pre-upgrade backup; the rows this corrected cannot be told apart from feedback that failed after upgrade.
